work_window_utc.meaning: Parallel source implementation, source/payload pin review and focused inert checks; not runtime or acceptance performance.

implementation: One fixed private worker-owned ingress store creates a permanent startup claim before listener publication; immutable startup, ingress, attempt and action records use direct final-name O_EXCL publication, fsync and retained held/named byte/identity checks.

Actual CLOCK_BOOTTIME is sampled at authenticated non-receipt complete-frame ingress before the native-attempt gate. The source hook retains the actual request, held open attempt/state and constructed forwarded action before any sensor connection.

The helper observes its own main-thread process identity, all four process accounts and active time namespace; no caller-selected root, clock, retry, repair, reset or resume API exists. Partial named writes remain evidence and refuse restart.

Fatal retention errors escape ordinary NOT_SUBMITTED and connection-loop handling. The permanent relay-consumption set is not reset; helper descriptor cleanup attempts all closes and preserves the primary failure.

The independent consumer verifies canonical caller-pinned bytes, ordered hash links, stable worker/binding/namespace identity, strict timestamps, receipt-tail/genesis/event joins and actual request/action payload and operation associations without importing the producer.

The source-only renderer pins the frozen create-gated worker and reviewed helper, applies reversible exact transforms, and publishes only the worker source. Common73, deployment units, activators, installed inventories and frozen predecessors remain unchanged.
review_findings_resolved: Cleanup originally chained a secondary close error instead of the primary retention cause; the helper now retains the original cause, notes secondary cleanup failure, and attempts every close. A partial-write plus close-failure check covers this.

Gate post-read/unlock and relay/service cleanup must not turn a fatal retention failure into ordinary cancellation or another accepted operation. Exact rendered-source checks cover failure identity, once-only consumption, descriptor cleanup and stopped acceptance.

Producer/consumer contract review and actual emitted-byte integration checks distinguish retained document associations from complete receipt history, protected path observation, source/placement attestation, clock-domain proof and qualification.
pipeline_command: /opt/homebrew/bin/python3.12 -S -B scripts/phase3_pipeline.py run worker-ingress-retention worker-ingress-verifier worker-ingress-renderer worker-ingress-integration

reviewed_input_closure.meaning: Explicit transitive local imports plus precisely read pinned source/payload inputs. Renderer closure includes complete predecessor quarantine payload and journal source even though inert execution replaces its journal import. Unused protected-install producer maps, broader common preparation, full native-receipt stager and historical test modules are excluded. Imported InertStore is a fixture, not historical test discovery. Runner, interpreter/platform, requirements and prerequisite fingerprint are separately bound.

limitations: All new behavioral checks use explicit inert kernel/account/namespace/clock/receipt/transport doubles and temporary data-only stores. These records are not real native observations, performance samples or replacement acceptance evidence.
The worker source overlay alone is not deployable. No helper installation, state-directory provisioning, unit/activator migration or common installed-source inventory change was made.

Ingress occurs after authenticated complete-frame receipt and receipt-only dispatch, not at native tool-call start or socket acceptance. The one-shot store may be consumed by a malformed non-receipt frame and cannot be reset for another attempt.

Custody and active-namespace checks are point-in-time and local worker-owned, not continuous immutability or hostile-owner/root anti-rollback. Synchronous retention has unqualified overhead and no hard deadline.

The retained consumer does not establish actual gateway authentication, running-source/placement attestation, full receipt-prefix verification, protected path/parameter identity, boot or cross-process clock comparability, broker final decision, elapsed time, sink acknowledgment, effect or causal attribution.

External one-collector clock-domain observations, effective broker final-decision joins and concrete real attempt/workload callbacks remain required. Remaining admission and RUN/sensor-health implementation and final31 plus100-attempt/100-pair acceptance remain blocked.
next_dependency: Migrate the ingress helper and pinned worker with private state-directory provisioning, unit, activator and installed-source inventory together in the existing common successor. Preserve frozen predecessors and truthful stage-derived worker artifacts. Then join retained ingress, one-collector boot/active-time-namespace observations and effective broker final-decision evidence through the existing independent measurement path before real prepared-attempt/workload callback execution.
checkpoint_commit: Create one signed local commit, verify signature and clean tree, and retain its hash in ignored .aragorn/phase3-batch-<short-hash>-checkpoint.json. No automatic push.
